summary: A light-weight elbow-bending exercise. This version follows a gentle public-sector strength routine, with standing or seated execution.

muscleRoles.qualifier: Elbow flexion role; no activation percentage or exact isolation claim.

setup: Hold light weights with feet about hip-width apart.
executionSteps: Keep upper arms beside the body and bend the elbows slowly, bringing the weights toward the shoulders.
Lower slowly back to the starting position.
technique.finishOrReset: Return to the start under control; the source also allows sitting.
keyCheckpoints: Upper arms remain beside the body; move slowly.

mistakes.mistake: Moving the upper arms away from the sides during the described curl.
mistakes.whyItMatters: This changes the setup described by the source.
mistakes.correction: Return to the stated arm position and use the light-weight version.

programmingGuidance.qualifier: This gentle source routine gives three sets of five curls per arm. It is not a universal strength or hypertrophy prescription. Rest and breathing timing are not specified by this source.

stopSignals: Stop if exercise produces pain or you become unwell.
safety.notes: Seek qualified advice when unsure about suitability, with a health problem, injury, symptoms, recent surgery, pregnancy or other concerns. Source video safety context; no individual clearance.

media.alt: Original movement schematic showing the upper arm beside the body as the elbow bends; not an anatomical model.
media.whySelected: Machine-checked against the stated written movement cue. No human technique review.
